```{r making settings for features}
f <- f0 # Reset to the original generated panel before each scenario.
n_reps <- 3
strength <- 1 # 0 = no WT/KO difference; 0.5 = weaker; 2 = stronger.
target_depth <- 100 # Expected site reads per sample, not an exact count.
phi <- 50 # Beta precision: smaller = more extra variation.

#The below explains how much differenct we want beteen WT/KO. 0 = no difference, 0.5 = weaker; 2 = stronger. Ours is on 1. 
#This has to be done for all contrasts
f$site_info$de_logit_shift_conditionADAR1KO_mock <- strength * f0$site_info$de_logit_shift_conditionADAR1KO_mock

f$site_info$de_logit_shift_conditionADAR1KO_IFNb <- strength * f0$site_info$de_logit_shift_conditionADAR1KO_IFNb

f$site_info$de_logit_shift_conditionADAR1p150KO_IFNb <- strength * f0$site_info$de_logit_shift_conditionADAR1p150KO_IFNb

f$site_info$de_logit_shift_conditionADAR1p150KO_mock <- strength * f0$site_info$de_logit_shift_conditionADAR1p150KO_mock

f$site_info$de_logit_shift_conditionWT_IFNb <- strength * f0$site_info$de_logit_shift_conditionWT_IFNb


f$site_info$editing_sampling_model <- "beta_binomial"

#How big do we want the variance. Smaller number = bigger variance
f$site_info$precision <- phi

#Every transcript gets the same mean 
f$transcript_info$baseline_expr <- 1000
f$site_info$site_depth_multiplier <- target_depth / 1000
f$site_info$coverage_fraction <- f$site_info$site_depth_multiplier

#To normalize the data?
p$design$lib_condition_scale[] <- 1
p$design$lib_sdlog <- 0

#How many repetitions per condition
# p$design$n_per_condition[] <- n_reps


```

```{r pooled editing code}
#Pooled editing across all samples:

min_editing <- 0.10

overall <- rowSums(counts$alt) / rowSums(counts$alt + counts$ref)
pass_edit <- overall >= min_editing
```


```{r filtering sites by 10 percentage and at least 2 replictaes}
min_depth   <- 10   # per-replicate usable depth
min_alt     <- 2    # reads needed to call a site detected in a replicate
min_reps    <- 2    # replicates per condition
min_editing <- 0.10

prop  <- counts$alt / (counts$alt + counts$ref)
usable <- (counts$alt + counts$ref) >= min_depth
cond  <- counts$sample_info$condition

# per-replicate detection
detected <- usable & counts$alt >= min_alt

# collapse to conditions
by_cond <- function(mat, f) sapply(split(seq_len(ncol(mat)), cond),
                                   function(j) f(mat[, j, drop = FALSE]))

n_detected <- by_cond(detected, function(m) rowSums(m))
mean_edit  <- by_cond(prop * usable, rowSums) / pmax(by_cond(usable, rowSums), 1)

pass_reps <- apply(n_detected, 1, max) >= min_reps
pass_edit <- apply(mean_edit,  1, max) >= min_editing
keep      <- pass_reps & pass_edit

sites <- counts$site_info$site_id[keep]
```

```{r plots of editing proportions, scatters plots comparing WT vs ADAR_KO, Site numbers}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# ggplot2 plots for an A2iSimR two-group simulation
# (WT_mock vs ADAR1KO_mock)
#
# Expects `counts <- a2i_refalt_counts(sim)` in the environment.
# Needs ggplot2 only; reshaping is done in base R.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

library(ggplot2)

# Define the conditions
COND_A <- "WT_mock"        # x axis / reference
COND_B <- "ADAR1KO_mock"   # y axis

# Define the percentage of what should be edited and how many replicates the editing has been observed
MIN_DEPTH   <- 10
MIN_ALT     <- 2
MIN_REPS    <- 2
MIN_EDITING <- 0.10

# Color palette
PAL <- c(null = "#BDBDBD", editable = "#2C7FB8", differential = "#D7301F")

# Define the theme
theme_a2i <- theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

# ---- shared quantities ----------------------------------------

a2i_prep <- function(counts,
                     min_depth = MIN_DEPTH,
                     min_alt   = MIN_ALT) {
  cond     <- as.character(counts$sample_info$condition)
  usable_n <- counts$alt + counts$ref

  prop     <- usable_n
  prop[]   <- NA_real_
  ok       <- usable_n > 0
  prop[ok] <- counts$alt[ok] / usable_n[ok]

  usable   <- usable_n >= min_depth
  detected <- usable & counts$alt >= min_alt

  by_cond <- function(f) {
    idx <- split(seq_along(cond), cond)
    do.call(cbind, lapply(idx, f))
  }

  n_usable   <- by_cond(function(j) rowSums(usable[, j, drop = FALSE]))
  n_detected <- by_cond(function(j) rowSums(detected[, j, drop = FALSE]))

  # mean of per-replicate proportions, over usable replicates only
  mean_edit <- by_cond(function(j) {
    p <- prop[, j, drop = FALSE]; u <- usable[, j, drop = FALSE]
    n <- rowSums(u)
    ifelse(n > 0, rowSums(p * u, na.rm = TRUE) / n, NA_real_)
  })

  # depth-weighted pooled alternative
  pooled_edit <- by_cond(function(j) {
    a <- rowSums(counts$alt[, j, drop = FALSE])
    d <- rowSums(usable_n[, j, drop = FALSE])
    ifelse(d > 0, a / d, NA_real_)
  })

  mean_depth <- by_cond(function(j) rowMeans(usable_n[, j, drop = FALSE]))

  list(cond = cond, prop = prop, usable = usable, detected = detected,
       n_usable = n_usable, n_detected = n_detected,
       mean_edit = mean_edit, pooled_edit = pooled_edit,
       mean_depth = mean_depth, site_info = counts$site_info)
}

a2i_truth_class <- function(site_info,
                            de_col = "de_logit_shift_conditionADAR1KO_mock") {
  cls <- rep("null", nrow(site_info))
  cls[site_info$editable] <- "editable"
  if (de_col %in% names(site_info)) {
    cls[site_info$editable & site_info[[de_col]] != 0] <- "differential"
  }
  factor(cls, levels = c("null", "editable", "differential"))
}

a2i_keep <- function(pr, min_reps = MIN_REPS, min_editing = MIN_EDITING) {
  pass_reps <- apply(pr$n_detected, 1, max) >= min_reps
  edit_max  <- suppressWarnings(apply(pr$mean_edit, 1, max, na.rm = TRUE))
  pass_reps & is.finite(edit_max) & edit_max >= min_editing
}

# tidy one row per site, for the scatter family
a2i_site_df <- function(pr, keep = NULL,
                        estimator = c("mean", "pooled"),
                        de_col = "de_logit_shift_conditionADAR1KO_mock") {
  estimator <- match.arg(estimator)
  m <- if (estimator == "mean") pr$mean_edit else pr$pooled_edit
  if (is.null(keep)) keep <- rep(TRUE, nrow(m))

  df <- data.frame(
    site_id    = pr$site_info$site_id[keep],
    site_class = pr$site_info$site_class[keep],
    x          = m[keep, COND_A],
    y          = m[keep, COND_B],
    depth      = rowMeans(pr$mean_depth[keep, , drop = FALSE]),
    truth      = a2i_truth_class(pr$site_info, de_col)[keep],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  df[is.finite(df$x) & is.finite(df$y), ]
}

# ---- 1. scatter: WT vs ADAR1KO, linear + logit facets ----------

a2i_gg_scatter <- function(pr, keep = NULL,
                           estimator = c("mean", "pooled"),
                           eps = 0.005) {
  df <- a2i_site_df(pr, keep, estimator)
  lg <- function(v) log((v + eps) / (1 - v + eps))

  long <- rbind(
    transform(df, xv = df$x,     yv = df$y,     scale = "linear"),
    transform(df, xv = lg(df$x), yv = lg(df$y), scale = "logit")
  )
  long$scale <- factor(long$scale, levels = c("linear", "logit"))

  ggplot(long, aes(xv, yv, colour = truth, size = depth)) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,
                linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
    facet_wrap(~scale, scales = "free") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = PAL, name = "truth") +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.6, 3), name = "mean depth") +
    labs(x = paste(COND_A, "editing"),
         y = paste(COND_B, "editing"),
         title = "Editing proportion, WT vs ADAR1KO",
         subtitle = sprintf("%s estimator; logit panel uses eps = %.3f",
                            match.arg(estimator), eps)) +
    theme_a2i
}

# ---- 2. MA-style: difference vs level --------------------------

a2i_gg_ma <- function(pr, keep = NULL, estimator = c("mean", "pooled")) {
  df <- a2i_site_df(pr, keep, estimator)
  df$avg <- (df$x + df$y) / 2
  df$dif <- df$y - df$x

  ggplot(df, aes(avg, dif, colour = truth)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.4) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = PAL, name = "truth") +
    labs(x = "mean editing across conditions",
         y = paste0(COND_B, " \u2212 ", COND_A),
         title = "Difference vs level") +
    theme_a2i
}

# ---- 3a. filter cascade ---------------------------------------

a2i_gg_cascade <- function(pr, min_reps = MIN_REPS, min_editing = MIN_EDITING) {
  pass_reps <- apply(pr$n_detected, 1, max) >= min_reps
  edit_max  <- suppressWarnings(apply(pr$mean_edit, 1, max, na.rm = TRUE))
  pass_edit <- is.finite(edit_max) & edit_max >= min_editing

  labs_ <- c("simulated",
             "any usable depth",
             sprintf("detected in >=%d reps", min_reps),
             sprintf("+ >=%d%% editing", round(min_editing * 100)))
  df <- data.frame(
    step = factor(labs_, levels = labs_),
    n    = c(nrow(pr$n_detected),
             sum(rowSums(pr$n_usable) > 0),
             sum(pass_reps),
             sum(pass_reps & pass_edit))
  )

  ggplot(df, aes(step, n)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#4292C6", width = 0.7) +
    geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -0.4, size = 3.4) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "sites", title = "Filter cascade") +
    theme_a2i +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
}

# ---- 3b. detected sites per condition, by site class -----------

a2i_gg_by_class <- function(pr, min_reps = MIN_REPS) {
  conds <- colnames(pr$n_detected)
  df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(conds, function(cn) {
    hit <- pr$n_detected[, cn] >= min_reps
    tb  <- as.data.frame(table(site_class = pr$site_info$site_class[hit]),
                         stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    tb$condition <- cn
    tb
  }))
  names(df)[names(df) == "Freq"] <- "n"

  ggplot(df, aes(condition, n, fill = site_class)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.65) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = hcl.colors(length(unique(df$site_class)),
                                          "Zissou 1"),
                      name = "site class") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "detected sites",
         title = sprintf("Sites detected in >=%d replicates", min_reps)) +
    theme_a2i
}

# ---- 3c. replicate sharing ------------------------------------

a2i_gg_sharing <- function(pr) {
  conds <- colnames(pr$n_detected)
  mx <- max(pr$n_detected)
  df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(conds, function(cn) {
    tb <- as.data.frame(table(n_reps = factor(pr$n_detected[, cn],
                                              levels = 0:mx)),
                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    tb$condition <- cn
    tb
  }))
  names(df)[names(df) == "Freq"] <- "n"
  df$n_reps <- as.integer(as.character(df$n_reps))

  ggplot(df, aes(factor(n_reps), n, fill = condition)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.75) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = MIN_REPS + 0.5,
               linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#2C7FB8", "#D7301F")) +
    labs(x = "replicates with the site detected", y = "sites",
         title = "Replicate sharing",
         subtitle = "dashed line marks the cutoff") +
    theme_a2i
}

# ---- 4. editing level distribution ----------------------------

a2i_gg_density <- function(pr, keep = NULL) {
  m <- pr$mean_edit
  if (is.null(keep)) keep <- rep(TRUE, nrow(m))
  df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(colnames(m), function(cn) {
    v <- m[keep, cn]
    v <- v[is.finite(v) & v > 0]
    if (!length(v)) return(NULL)
    data.frame(condition = cn, edit = v, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))

  ggplot(df, aes(edit, colour = condition, fill = condition)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 0.8) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("#2C7FB8", "#D7301F")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#2C7FB8", "#D7301F")) +
    labs(x = "editing proportion (log scale)", y = "density",
         title = "Editing level distribution",
         subtitle = "detected sites only; the mass at zero is not shown") +
    theme_a2i
}

# ---- run -------------------------------------------------------
pr   <- a2i_prep(counts)
keep <- a2i_keep(pr)
#
ggsave("scatter.png",  a2i_gg_scatter(pr, keep),  width = 10, height = 4.5, dpi = 150)
ggsave("ma.png",       a2i_gg_ma(pr, keep),       width = 6,  height = 4.5, dpi = 150)
ggsave("cascade.png",  a2i_gg_cascade(pr),        width = 5.5, height = 4.5, dpi = 150)
ggsave("byclass.png",  a2i_gg_by_class(pr),       width = 6,  height = 4.5, dpi = 150)
ggsave("sharing.png",  a2i_gg_sharing(pr),        width = 7,  height = 4.5, dpi = 150)
ggsave("density.png",  a2i_gg_density(pr, keep),  width = 6,  height = 4.5, dpi = 150)
#
# With patchwork installed you can compose a single panel:
library(patchwork)
(a2i_gg_cascade(pr) | a2i_gg_by_class(pr)) / a2i_gg_scatter(pr, keep)
```



```{r true KO effect after filtering}
# Ground truth for the sites that survive the filter
shift_col <- "de_logit_shift_conditionADAR1KO_mock"

si      <- pr$site_info     # the site table that was actually simulated
si_kept <- si[keep, ]       # only sites that passed the filter

# Numbers for the subtitle
n_total     <- nrow(si)
n_diff_all  <- sum(si[[shift_col]] != 0)
n_kept      <- nrow(si_kept)
n_diff_kept <- sum(si_kept[[shift_col]] != 0)

shift_df <- data.frame(
  shift      = si_kept[[shift_col]],
  site_class = si_kept$site_class
)
shift_df <- shift_df[shift_df$shift != 0, ]

truth <- ggplot(shift_df, aes(shift)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "grey40") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  labs(title = "True editing shift after filtering, ADAR1KO_mock vs WT_mock",
       subtitle = sprintf("%d of %d kept sites are differentially edited (%d differential sites before filtering)",
                          n_diff_kept, n_kept, n_diff_all),
       x = "de_logit_shift (KO - WT, logit scale)", y = "number of sites") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)

truth
ggsave("truth_mock_filtered.png", truth, width = 6, height = 4.5, dpi = 150)
```
